resources.string: Review unfinished exports and copies outside your private album. These actions never delete private originals.
No export recovery records. Completed or interrupted exports will appear here when there is a record to review.
The previous export ended without a confirmed result. Review its recovery record before exporting again.
The result is unconfirmed. Refresh to review the current status before trying again.
Stopped waiting. Refresh to check the current status before another action.
Export completed. Review the published result to open it.
The reviewed partial copy was removed. Private originals were not deleted.
Recovery record closed. No exported file was deleted.
A complete unencrypted copy is staged. Complete checks it again before making it visible outside your private album.
This exported copy is outside your private album. Open checks it again. Closing this result removes only its recovery record, not the file.
The export did not finish. You can request removal of only the exact pending copy in this reviewed record; its current identity and contents are checked first.
The recorded output is missing. Forget removes its recovery record only. Exporting again may create a duplicate if an earlier copy still exists elsewhere.
The output no longer matches the recorded identity or contents. No file deletion is offered. Forget removes tracking only; an unencrypted copy may remain.
The output identity is unconfirmed after interruption. No file is adopted or deleted by name. Forget removes tracking only; an unencrypted copy may remain.
Remove only the pending output identified by this reviewed record? Its identity and contents will be checked again before deletion. Private originals are not deleted.
Close this recovery record without deleting any exported file? An unencrypted copy may still exist outside the private album. Exporting again may create duplicates.
